generation.mode: single built-in image_gen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin full-angle land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.canonicalNodeGateEnvironmentLimitation: The repository keylight-map.mjs could not run because this sandbox has no node executable and no local sharp installation; the numerically reported fields come from the quarantined System.Drawing implementation using the same central-difference threshold concept.
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell cast-shadow field is visible, but repeated basalt caps and bench tops are materially paler than vertical column faces. The low signed first moment does not override this literal violation of the equal-value lighting rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad top, middle, and lower bench surfaces and the northern approach count as buildable; exposed column faces and the sharpest talus drops count as steep; scree, broken edge ground, vegetation, and biome transitions make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Screen-space visual estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

crown.method: Full-frame native-resolution dark-conifer component census of all 31 discernible crowns, including saplings and clipped edge crowns; median outer foliage-envelope width 20 source pixels scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

crownEvidence.limitation: The median is inside the binding 1.7-to-5.2-metre band but below the requested three-to-four-metre target; dense or overlapping painted foliage remains a visual census judgment.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank span traces of the tarn, required southern stream, and all inherited west/east bleed water, including complete wash, ripple highlights, reflections, and water between stones; the binary overlay was inspected over the raw source.

refusalReasons: The binding flat-lighting rule fails visually: many pale bench tops and basalt caps sit over substantially darker vertical faces.
Several long bench walls read as regular, repeating column palisades rather than consistently weathered irregular geology.
The tarn open-water diameter measures about 22.2 metres at the declared final scale, materially short of the requested roughly 30 metres.
openRisks: The northern solid rise and level approach are visually present, but a 15-to-20-metre true vertical height cannot be proven from this single high-oblique raster.
The wind arch reads as natural geology with a level shelf, but its exact twelve-metre span is a visual estimate rather than surveyed geometry.
The water mask is same-size, binary, five-component, and overlay-inspected; exact water-to-stone boundary placement remains a human visual gate.
The generated source is square, so the packet does not authorize a quality retry; no second image generation call was made.
No shipped-canvas bake, runtime mount, public write, art-source write, or owner visual acceptance was attempted because the result remains quarantine-only.

inspection.visualAcceptance: not claimed; director and owner review required
